text: This is PillWars. Real-time pill battles, where every kill pays.
Pick a duel, pay your entry in $PILLY, and fight.
Win, and the whole pot is yours.
Add a friend, make a group, and go 2v2.
Skins, guides, and daily quests. Pick three to track while you play.
In Classic, every kill takes your rival's tokens.
Five kills is a Pentakill. You leave with everything.
And the whole game fits in your pocket, on Solana Mobile.
PillWars. See you in the arena.
